51572e44aa.q: How many Shaping Portsmouth programmes exist and what is the significance of the recent restructuring?
51572e44aa.a: Shaping Portsmouth recently expanded from 11 programmes to approximately 19, pushing toward 20 programmes. The restructuring was necessary because what appeared as a single programme listing on the website often encompassed much larger and more complex work. Steff Jones explains that splitting them out revealed some programmes were massive in scope but poorly communicated, making it nearly impossible to tell their full story when they were bundled together under a single name.

52cf5698bf.q: How is Shaping Portsmouth restructuring its mentorship programme to improve mentor and mentee relationships?

f: Shaping Portsmouth is moving from a simple paired-matching model to a more structured approach. Rather than simply pairing mentors and mentees and leaving them to determine outcomes independently, the organization now focuses on creating defined pathways and journeys for both mentors and mentees. The programme includes mentor support training since mentors often come to Shaping Portsmouth wanting to mentor but without all necessary skills already developed. National Mentor Day on October 27th brings together experienced and less experienced mentors to provide feedback, connect with each other, and discuss how the journey is working. The organization is also tracking long-term impact of mentee relationships three to five years down the line.
